body.description: One REST GoogleAdsRow of Q-G1 (SELECT customer.id, customer.descriptive_name, customer.currency_code, customer.time_zone FROM customer), returned as an element of results[] in the n8n envelope defined by search.json, whose headers, body and paging rules govern the call. camelCase keys; int64 values are strings. Q-G1 is the Google probe and gives the account currency and the time zone that sets Google's native day for segments.date (AAP 0.5.4.1).

resourceName.description: customers/{customer_id}; always returned for the FROM resource.

id.description: INT64 as a JSON string: the 10-digit customer id.

descriptiveName.description: Optional; absent when the account has no descriptive name.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency of every amount in this account; amounts are never converted across currencies.

timeZone.description: Account time-zone id (e.g. America/New_York). Google daily rows (segments.date) are dates in this zone and are never rebucketed.
